notes.title: Steam Next Fest Event: Escape, Love, and Adventure - Furry Finder
notes.content:
Step into the world of love and adventure in[b] Furry Finder![/b] Join us on February 6th at 11:30 PM CET for the Steam Next Fest broadcast. Play as Alexis, the shy protagonist looking for true love, and navigate the dating app "Furry Finder." With the help of your friend Sophie, you'll overcome your shyness and navigate the ups and downs of dating. Your choices will determine your future, so choose wisely. Will you find true love, or will you end up alone? The outcome is in your hands! Don't miss this exciting visual novel game and add Furry Finder to your Steam [b]wishlist now[/b]. See you on February 6th for the journey of love and adventure.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1593510/Furry_Finder__Dating_Visual_Novel/
